import subprocess, os, importlib
import build123d as bd
import numpy as np
print("build123d", bd.__version__)

# ---- parameters (metres) ----
BAR = 0.045       # barrel radius
H   = 0.120       # barrel height
FIN = 0.070       # fin radius
FT  = 0.003       # fin thickness
GAP = 0.006       # air gap
NF  = 12
DUCT = 0.300      # duct square side
BELOW, ABOVE = 0.150, 0.300

# fin stack spans 12*3 + 11*6 = 102 mm; centre it vertically
stack = NF*FT + (NF-1)*GAP          # 0.102 m
z0 = (H - stack)/2                  # first fin start, 0.009

# cylinder solid pieces
barrel = bd.Cylinder(BAR, H)         # z from -H/2..H/2 -> move later
dome = bd.Sphere(BAR).located(bd.Location((0,0,H)))  # trim later
cyl = barrel.moved(bd.Location((0,0,H/2)))
# dome: keep only upper half of sphere at top
half = bd.Pos(0,0,H) * bd.Box(2*BAR,2*BAR,H)
head = cyl + (bd.Sphere(BAR) & (bd.Pos(0,0,H)*bd.Box(2*BAR,2*BAR,H)))
fins = bd.Compound(
    [ (bd.Cylinder(FIN,FT)).moved(bd.Location((0,0,z0 + i*(FT+GAP) + FT/2)))
      for i in range(NF)])
cyl += fins
z_top = H + BAR              # 0.165, dome apex
z_min, z_max = -BELOW, z_top + ABOVE
duct = bd.Pos(0,0,(z_min+z_max)/2) * bd.Box(DUCT, DUCT, z_max-z_min)

# fluid = duct minus cylinder(barrel+fins+head)
fluid = duct - cyl
print("fluid volume:", fluid.volume, "  bbox:", fluid.bounding_box())
z_thresh = None
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyvista import Plotter
bb = cyl.bounding_box()
plt.figure(figsize=(5,5))
pl = Plotter(off_screen=True)
pl.add_mesh(bd.to_vtkshape(cyl) if hasattr(bd,'to_vtkshape') else cyl.wrapped, color='tan')
pl.view_isometric()
plt.close()
print("done")

barrel = bd.Cylinder(BAR, H).moved(bd.Location((0,0,H/2)))
head_s = bd.Sphere(BAR) & (bd.Pos(0,0,H)*bd.Box(2*BAR,2*BAR,H))
fin_list = [bd.Cylinder(FIN,FT).moved(bd.Location((0,0,z0 + i*(FT+GAP) + FT/2))) for i in range(NF)]
fins_s = fin_list[0]

Lcyl = z_max - z_min
duct = bd.Pos(0,0,(z_min+z_max)/2) * bd.Box(DUCT, DUCT, Lcyl)

# duct faces: classify by normal

                  ("inlet",inlet),("outlet",outlet),("walls",walls)]:
    bd.export_stl(shp, out+name+".stl")
    print(name, "faces:", len(shp.faces()))

import os
import build123d as bd

# ---- parameters (metres) ----
BAR, H   = 0.045, 0.120    # barrel radius, height
FIN, FT, GAP, NF = 0.070, 0.003, 0.006, 12
DUCT = 0.300
BELOW, ABOVE = 0.150, 0.300

stack = NF*FT + (NF-1)*GAP     # 0.102
z0 = (H - stack)/2             # 0.009, fin stack centred on barrel
z_top = H + BAR                # dome apex 0.165
z_min, z_max = -BELOW, z_top + ABOVE
Lcyl = z_max - z_min

# cylinder pieces (separate overlapping solids)
barrel = bd.Cylinder(BAR, H).moved(bd.Location((0,0,H/2)))
sph = bd.Sphere(BAR).moved(bd.Location((0,0,H)))
cap_box = bd.Pos(0,0,H+BAR/2) * bd.Box(2*BAR,2*BAR,BAR)
head_s = sph & cap_box
fin_list = [bd.Cylinder(FIN,FT).moved(bd.Location((0,0,z0 + i*(FT+GAP) + FT/2)))
            for i in range(NF)]
fins_s = fin_list[0]
for f in fin_list[1:]:
    fins_s = fins_s + f

duct = bd.Pos(0,0,(z_min+z_max)/2) * bd.Box(DUCT, DUCT, Lcyl)

def face_group(shape, target):
    return bd.Compound([f for f in shape.faces()
                        if tuple(round(v,6) for v in f.normal_at())==target])
inlet  = face_group(duct,(0,0,-1))
outlet = face_group(duct,(0,0, 1))
walls  = bd.Compound([f for f in duct.faces() if abs(f.normal_at().Z)<1e-6])

os.makedirs("constant/triSurface", exist_ok=True)
for name, shp in [("barrel",barrel),("fins",fins_s),("head",head_s),
                  ("inlet",inlet),("outlet",outlet),("walls",walls)]:
    bd.export_stl(shp, "constant/triSurface/"+name+".stl")
    print(name, "faces:", len(shp.faces()), " vol/area:",
          round(shp.volume if hasattr(shp,'volume') and shp.volume else shp.area, 6))
print("duct z:", z_min, "->", z_max, "  fin zs:", z0, "...", round(z0+11*(FT+GAP)+FT,4))
